    Why I built this ♡

    It started small and personal.

    Photo unavailable
    A note from the creator

    Hi, I’m Maziha.

    Next Tiny Thing began as something I wanted to make for someone close to me who was having a hard time with the gap between knowing what needed to be done and actually being able to start.

    I didn’t want to build another productivity system that added more pressure. I wanted something gentler: a place that could make the next step visible, shrink an overwhelming task, and feel a little more like a friend than another list of expectations.

    As I thought about it more, I realized that this kind of friction is not unique to one person. So I decided to make the tool free and share it more widely — and to keep improving it based on what people actually find useful.

    Built with care, curiosity, and a belief that sometimes progress really can start with one tiny thing.

    This project is a general self-help and organization resource. It does not diagnose executive dysfunction or replace medical or mental-health care.

    About this tool: Next Tiny Thing is a general self-help and organization tool. It is not a diagnostic, medical, or mental-health treatment service. Your brain dump is stored only in your own browser when you choose “Save on this device.”
    Hi. I’m your tiny corner friend.
